{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Blouse: relaxed long-sleeve blouse with a soft tie neck, hip-grazing length, rust terracotta #B5502D, matte satin-finish crepe

Trousers: high-waisted straight-leg trousers, ankle length, deep forest green #24493A, wool-blend crepe

Trench coat: single-breasted trench, knee length, belted, camel #B98B5A, water-repellent cotton gabardine

Ankle boots: block-heel ankle boots with a rounded toe, dark chocolate #3B2518, waterproof smooth leather

Bag: structured top-handle bag, medium size, burgundy #5E1A2A, grained leather

Earrings: medium hoop earrings, warm gold #C9A24B, polished brass

Umbrella: compact automatic umbrella, dark olive #3E4A2F, windproof nylon

This outfit stays within a neat business look, with a blouse, tailored trousers, ankle boots and a trench, while the rust and forest green pairing gives the bold, memorable color she wants for a client meeting. These warm, deep shades suit her warm skin, dark brown hair and hazel eyes, so the color works for her rather than overpowering her. The high-waisted straight trousers and belted trench create a long, clean line, and the soft tie neck adds a point of interest near the face. The waterproof boots, water-repellent trench and umbrella keep her polished and dry through a rainy autumn day, so she can focus on the client."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2718,"output_tokens":1178},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
